test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1): Morning Practice - Day 1
subject: general
question: A man spends 5% of his total income in Travelling & 20% of the rest spends on Food and then he donates Rs. 120 and he still Left with Rs. 1400; find his income?
solution:
**Given:**

A man spends 5% on travelling

20% of the rest is spent on food

Donates = Rs. 120

Money left with him = Rs. 1400

**Calculation:**

Let the Total income be x

The man spent on travelling = 5x/100

The man spent on food = 20% of (x – 5x/100) = 19x/100

1400 = x – (5x/100) – (19x/100) – 120

1520 = 19x/25

x = 2000

**∴ Income of the man is Rs. 2000**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3a64655bd0032ec70560d89905810cb57f98bb354cacbd304db7193ce5de15d.png] **

The man spends 5% of the total on travelling

Rest is 100 - 5 = 95%

He spends 20% of 95% of total income on food** **

**⇒ **He'll spend 19% of the total income on food

Total he spend on food and travelling = 19 + 5 = 24%

Remaining = 100 - 24 = 76% of the total income

76% of the total income = 1400 + 120 = 1520

⇒ Total income = 1520/(76/100) = 2000

∴ Income of the man is Rs. 2000
